verdict.rationale: Belvo's own pricing page lists a 'Customizable Connect Widget' and a 'No-code solution', so a drop-in linking UI exists. Separate docs describe links as the resulting connected-account object, with external_id support. Nothing documents the server-side session or token creation, how the widget is opened, or the widget returning a link ID or token. Missing for 10: documented server-side widget access token or session creation, widget embed/launch instructions, a callback returning the link ID or token, and independent hands-on corroboration.
